items.html: And behold, it has been explained in brief that in Atzilut of holiness the light of AA was hidden, and therefore the light of Malchut, the Nukva of ZA, returned to the secret of a single point of light alone, which is the aspect of her Malchut alone. And her nine first ones were clothed in the nine Sefirot of the Nukva of the Klipot of Atzilut, which before the correction had only a single point, which is her Malchut. And now her ten Sefirot were completed, with ten lights. But in ZA of the Klipa of Atzilut, which is VAK, he was also corrected to ten Sefirot, but he has only six lights.
